title: Invertibility of compact-support exchange for geometric Frobenius
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum of [def-fix-six-functor-datum], in particular $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k_0$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a separated finite-type morphism between separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes, and put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$, $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$, $f=f_0\times_{k_0}k$. Let $g_X,g_Y$ be the geometric-Frobenius scheme automorphisms of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. Use raw rationalized bounded constructible pro-etale coefficient categories and derived pullbacks as in [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. The Cartesian Frobenius square $fg_X=g_Yf$, with source corners carrying the $k$-structures $a_Xg_X$ and $a_Yg_Y$, has the compact-support exchange of [fix-lem-exchanges]. This exchange is a natural isomorphism
$$a_f:Lg_Y^*Rf_!\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_!Lg_X^*$$
on every object of $D^b_c(X,E)$, without imposing a Weil structure on that object. The Frobenius maps here are semilinear scheme isomorphisms, with their corresponding automorphism of $k$; no $k$-linearity of $g_X,g_Y$ is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the existing theorem WeilConjectures.PodConstructibleMate.frobenius_exchanges_isIso from [lem-pod-constructible-mate-coherence] with the same finite-field datum, prime, finite coefficient extension, model morphism and chosen compactification. For its auxiliary common-stage field take the algebraic closure of Q_l, which has the canonical Q_l-algebra and algebraic-closure instances. Its hypotheses only require finite-type model schemes and a separated finite-type relative morphism; these are among the present hypotheses. Its first conjunct is literally the required IsIso of frobeniusRational at frobeniusCompactModel, so project that conjunct. No Weil structure, k-linearity or new input-domain hypothesis is introduced.
